tasks.label: build
args: if not exist bin mkdir bin && "D:\c++\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && nvcc -arch=sm_75 -std=c++17 -Xcompiler /MD -I "C:/Users/USER/Desktop/dev/libs/glfw/include" -I "C:/Users/USER/Desktop/dev/libs/glad/include" -I "C:/Users/USER/Desktop/dev/libs/glm" -I src -I src/imgui src/main.cpp src/glad.c src/kernel.cu src/imgui/imgui.cpp src/imgui/imgui_draw.cpp src/imgui/imgui_tables.cpp src/imgui/imgui_widgets.cpp src/imgui/imgui_impl_glfw.cpp src/imgui/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp -L "C:/Users/USER/Desktop/dev/libs/glfw/lib-vc2022" -lglfw3 -lopengl32 -luser32 -lgdi32 -lshell32 -lcomdlg32 -Xlinker /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS -Xlinker /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup -o bin/main.exe
